title_zh: 汕尾电厂配套煤码头工程初步设计
title_en: Preliminary Design of the Supporting Coal Wharf Project for Shanwei Power Plant
abstract_zh: 本设计针对汕尾电厂燃料煤运输需求，开展5万吨级配套煤码头工程的初步设计工作。在分析工程区域自然条件（水文、气象、地质）的基础上，依据《海港总体设计规范》（JTS 165-2025）、《码头结构设计规范》（JTS 167-2018）等现行港口工程规范，完成码头总平面布置、装卸工艺系统设计、水工结构方案比选、主要结构计算及工程量估算。设计船型为5万DWT散货船，码头年工作321天，每日纯作业21小时，工程处于有掩护海域，设计高水位1.91m，设计低水位0.22m，极端高水位3.56m，极端低水位-0.35m。通过泊位尺度、前沿水深、回旋水域、装卸能力、库场容量和桩基承载力等计算，确定码头泊位长度260m、码头面高程3.60m、前沿设计水深12.50m，推荐采用高桩梁板式码头结构。结构方案采用PHC管桩、现浇横梁、预制纵梁和叠合面板组合体系，并对竖向荷载、水平荷载、单桩承载力、桩基数量、梁板尺寸和工程量进行了初步验算。结果表明，高桩梁板式方案能够适应场区软弱淤泥质土和下部风化花岗岩地基条件，较重力式沉箱方案具有地基处理工程量小、施工风险低、综合造价合理等优点，可满足电厂专用煤码头安全、连续和高效运行要求。
keywords_zh: 煤码头，初步设计，高桩梁板式，装卸工艺，结构计算
abstract_en: This design carries out the preliminary design of a 50,000 DWT supporting coal wharf for Shanwei Power Plant according to the fuel coal transportation demand. Based on the analysis of hydrological, meteorological and geological conditions, and in accordance with the current port engineering codes, including JTS 165-2025 and JTS 167-2018, the general layout, cargo handling system, hydraulic structure scheme comparison, main structural calculation and quantity estimation are completed. The design vessel is a 50,000 DWT bulk carrier. The wharf operates 321 days per year and 21 effective hours per day. The project is located in a sheltered water area, with a design high water level of 1.91 m, a design low water level of 0.22 m, an extreme high water level of 3.56 m and an extreme low water level of -0.35 m. Through calculations of berth scale, front water depth, turning basin, handling capacity, yard capacity and pile bearing capacity, the berth length is determined as 260 m, the deck elevation as 3.60 m, and the front design water depth as 12.50 m. A piled beam-slab wharf is recommended. The structural system consists of PHC pipe piles, cast-in-place transverse beams, precast longitudinal beams and composite deck slabs. The preliminary checks cover vertical load, horizontal load, single pile capacity, pile number, beam-slab dimensions and major quantities. The results show that the piled beam-slab scheme can adapt to the soft muddy soil and weathered granite foundation of the site. Compared with a gravity caisson scheme, it requires less foundation treatment, has lower construction risk and more reasonable overall cost, and can meet the safety, continuity and efficiency requirements of the dedicated coal wharf.
keywords_en: Coal Wharf; Preliminary Design; Piled Beam-slab Structure; Handling Process; Structural Calculation
acknowledgement: 本毕业设计从选题、资料整理、规范查阅到方案计算和说明书成稿，得到了指导教师孙克俐老师的耐心指导。老师在码头总平面布置、装卸工艺选择、结构方案比选和计算书表达等方面提出了具体意见，使我能够逐步把课程知识转化为完整的工程设计成果，在此表示诚挚感谢。
感谢建筑工程学院各位老师在本科阶段的教学与培养。港口航道与海岸工程专业课程为本次设计提供了必要的理论基础，也使我在查阅规范、分析工程资料、进行结构计算和编制设计说明书的过程中更加严谨。
感谢家人和同学在毕业设计期间给予的理解、鼓励和帮助。由于本人专业水平有限，设计中仍可能存在不足，恳请各位老师批评指正。
